'''Numa's mother''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] of [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] Ryloth, leaving behind an orphaned daughter, [[Numa/Legends|Numa]].
